issues.problem: Only two papers (hm, tang), so validate.py failed with 'fewer than 3 papers'.
issues.fix: Opened arXiv:2506.21764 (Shekhar-Gupta, On Tor-vanishing of local rings, 2025) and read the abstract, §1 and §2, then added it as paper 'sg'. Its preliminaries use: vanishing of Tor_i(M,N) for i > pd, the Tor-vanishing property (the converse), Betti numbers as dim_k Tor_n(k,M) from minimal free resolutions, the Koszul complex on a minimal generating set of m, Poincaré series, Golod rings and DG algebras.

issues.problem: The page did not state the basic fact that the paper relies on: Tor_i(A,B) = 0 for i > pd A, or for i > pd B by balancing.

Reading the papers now has an item 3 for sg. The intro mentions the paper. Requires gained two core items (the vanishing fact, taught here; Betti numbers and pd, which point to [[ext]]) and two specialised items (general Koszul complex; Poincaré series, curvature, Golod rings, DG algebras), marked 'not covered here; see [sg]'.
